name: smithy
description: The smithy: repo-agnostic Claude Code plugins for engineering (forge), product scaffolding (foundry), writing (draft), Nix environments (anvil), recurring automation (bellows), and security (temper).

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Core engineering workflow: execute dev tasks, debug, prove findings, verify without mutating, refactor, evaluate options, review diffs, ship draft PRs, cut releases, generate MCP test harnesses, and run behavioral scenario evals.

plugins.name: foundry
plugins.description: Product factory: scaffold Clean Architecture project templates and deploy them with OpenTofu. Requires forge.

plugins.name: draft
plugins.description: Writing studio: books, poetry, technical articles, and repo documentation, with ebook compilation for publishing. Requires forge.

plugins.name: anvil
plugins.description: Nix environments: shell gates across dialects, distro-family portability audits, devenv environments, and confirmed machine activation. Requires forge.

plugins.name: bellows
plugins.description: Recurring automation: scheduled routines, watches over long-running work, CI pipelines, and dependency upgrades in tested batches. Requires forge.

plugins.name: temper
plugins.description: Security: repo-wide audits across secrets, dependencies, code, and configuration, then hardening one proven finding at a time. Requires forge.
